alternative_explanations: Any gain may be ordinary Re-Pair phrase reuse rather than a distinct equality-grammar mechanism; the mandatory registered Re-Pair control is the direct null.
Exact public-anchor matching may help only short syntax templates and fail under long masks, leaving PPM or unigram stronger.
confounds: The local corpus is visible screening evidence and one runner-random byte permutation cannot establish seed stability.
Exact-span accuracy may remain zero for all implementable roles, making the preregistered 0.02 gate stringent but decisive.
falsification_criteria: Discard unless shared improves aggregate bits per byte by at least 0.05 and exact-span accuracy by at least 0.02 versus both source-identical roles with no lower byte accuracy.
Discard unless shared beats the strongest complete implementable classical control by at least 0.05 bits per byte and 0.02 exact-span accuracy overall and in every K cell at rounds 4 and 6.
Discard on semantic recursion, relabeling, target-isolation, work-accounting, depth, expansion, state, source-identity, preflight, integrity or Pareto failure.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus mismatch or overlap with the EXP-0044 corpus.
Invalidate if a public query exposes a path, target byte, uncorrupted span or future refinement snapshot.
Invalidate if predictions within one round observe another prediction from that same round.
Invalidate if candidate critical-path work is sequentially hidden inside a declared simultaneous step.

Invalidate if the three equality-grammar roles differ in byte representation, grammar extractor, initialization, training data/order, constants, query alignment or output probabilities beyond the preregistered recursive, flat and frozen-grammar interventions.

Invalidate unless preregistered semantic fixtures prove that recursive completion requires at least two learned grammar levels, the flat ablation cannot solve that fixture, consistent byte relabeling preserves probabilities, no target is accessible and rule discovery, indexing, alignment and expansion work are explicit.
Invalidate unless the mandatory Re-Pair control passes its registered recursive-rule, completion and byte-relabeling semantic fixtures before seed realization.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, seed leakage, byte-permutation leakage or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify and discard this exact recursive equality-grammar rule without tuning support, limits, weighting, anchors or smoothing, then return to breadth.
outcome_policy.null: Return the hypothesis to dormant and stop this exact rule if grammar learning helps but recursive expansion adds no causal or full-cost advantage.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep HYP-0044 testing at cautious confidence and preregister only an unchanged three-seed adversarial-mask replication; do not promote.

predicted_outcome: Freeze one source-identical deterministic batch-pair grammar core: Dirichlet-1/2 prior, support at least 3, first-occurrence ties, at most 64 rules, recursive depth at most 6, eligible expansion length at most 32 and at least two public anchors. Shared uses all recursive expansions, flat only terminal-terminal rules and frozen no grammar votes. Votes equal log(1+creation support)*anchors/length. Predict a small long-span loss and exact-completion gain at rounds 4/6 while Re-Pair remains the decisive classical null.
promotion_criteria: This one-seed locally visible quick cannot promote or mark HYP-0044 promising; a fully conjunctive pass may only authorize unchanged three-seed replication with an adversarial mask variant.
research_question: Can recursively reused learned equality grammar improve masked-byte quality per full cost beyond flat and frozen source-identical roles, Re-Pair and classical sequence controls?
title: Recursive equality-grammar masked completion quick
